test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third term on the same basis as the second term is related to the first term.

Law of Motion : Issac Newton :: Theory of Relativity : ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Law of Motion : Issac Newton → Issac Newton is the person who is known for his work on the Law of Motion.

Similarly,

Theory of Relativity : Albert Einstein → Albert Einstein is the person who is known for his work on the Theory of Relativity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**James Chadwick is known for his discovery of the neutron, which helped to explain the structure of the atomic nucleus.

John Dalton is known for his work on atomic theory and the development of modern atomic theory.

J.J. Thomson is known for his discovery of the electron and his work on atomic structure.
